{{Top|leg|title=''Burst Fire''-class Deep-Space Patrol Vessel}}
The '''''Burst Fire''-class Deep-Space Patrol Vessel''', also called '''pocket corvette''', was a [[Realspace/Legends|deep space]] patrol vessel with usually 30 crewmembers used by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. It had a length of 60 [[Meter/Legends|Imperial standard meters]] and a complement of two [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] and one [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]].
